title: Ɔpanyin no Aduan a Wɔnhwɛ kwan
intro: Wɔ Allah Fie no mpɔtam kronkron no, Onyankopɔn akoa bi a ne mfe akɔ anim nyaa ahintasɛm bi a emu dɔ a ɛtia akwanhwɛ nyinaa. Saa onipa a ɔde ne ho ama yi, a atwam bere tenten a atwam wɔ abɔde mu awofoyɛ mfe no, huu biribi soronko bi a ɛdaa Ɔsoro mmɔborohunu a enni ano adi. Ahodwiriwde no gyina saa bere a werɛ afi yi a wobeyi afi adiyifo no asetra mu no mu.
clues: Ná wonim me nkurɔfo sɛ Israel, tete agya panyin kɛse bi asefo.
Medaa m’anadwo wɔ mpaebɔ mu, na mekotow m’Awurade anim wɔ asɔredan mu.
Wɔmaa me ɔbabarima wɔ me nkwakoraabere mu, akyɛdeɛ a mannyae sɛ mɛhyɛ Allah animuonyam da.
Nea ɛka me sɔhwɛ no ho ne sɛ mihuu aduan bi a epuei maa ɔkra kumaa bi a ɔhyɛ me hwɛ ase.
Na meyɛ nkɔmhyɛni bi a wɔfrɛ no Zakariyya, a wɔde ahyɛ me nsa sɛ menhwɛ Maryam wɔ Bayt al-Maqdis.
Mmuaeɛ no wɔ nkyekyɛmu a Allah gyee Maryam toom na ɔmaa no aduane no mu.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
